phyloplate_tester.description: BEAST X test XML files (squirrels ME clock, GTR strict, rec/mcmc priors, varv re-clock) used to verify parser, line-target, and prior-surfacing changes; loaded by the _debug_*.mjs scripts

parse-check.description: Verify the parser against the phyloplate_tester XMLs (duplicate ids, node counts, prior surfacing)
parse-check.template: Run `node _debug_parse.mjs` from the project root and report the output (duplicate ids, total vs unique node counts). If it fails because jsdom is missing, run `npm install` first. Then also run `node _debug_app.mjs` and `node _debug_layout.mjs` if they exist, and summarise any errors. Do not commit anything.
